name: Rhodes College
academic_ranking: Private liberal arts college in Memphis, TN. Reported acceptance rate approximately 50% and 6-year graduation rate about 84-85%. Cited by EDsmart as ranking around #188 nationally. Known as a selective liberal arts institution. Exact figures vary by source and year.
financial_aid: Reported 2025 tuition and fees approximately $57,110; total cost of attendance (on-campus) reported around $74,474 for 2024-2025. Average net price after aid reported near $30,590/year. Rhodes states it aims to make attendance possible for every admitted student through scholarships and grants. Source: third-party aggregators and Rhodes site via web search 2026-07; not confirmed on live rhodes.edu page (athletics domain blocked to fetch tool).
facilities_notes: Softball is an NCAA Division III sport, so no athletic scholarships are awarded. Home games played on campus in Memphis, TN. Specific facility/field details not confirmed (gorhodeslynx.com could not be fetched live).
program_reputation: NCAA Division III program competing in the Southern Athletic Association (SAA). Head coach Rebecca Arbino reported to be in her fourth season with the program (third as head coach) as of recent listings. Program participated in SAA competition through the 2025/2026 seasons.
notes: IMPORTANT DATA-SOURCING CAVEAT: The official athletics site (gorhodeslynx.com) consistently refused connections to the fetch tool (ECONNREFUSED / bot protection) throughout research on 2026-07.
